quarterly_data.signal: Improper-accounting liability: in its October 16, 2026 release on the report of its Executive Responsibility Investigation Committee, Nidec states that the committee's conclusion is that Shigenobu Nagamori, Hiroshi Kobe, Akira Sato, Hiroyuki Yoshimoto, Jun Seki and Mitsuya Kishida, and Kazuya Murakami and Hiroyuki Ochiai, are believed to be liable in damages under Article 423, Paragraph 1 of the Companies Act of Japan, and a former vice president (a former CFO, May 2022 - March 2026) under the Civil Code or Nidec's Vice President Regulations, the extent of damage to be determined by each one's contribution. Nidec says it recognizes cases in which multiple directors and others violated laws and regulations, and will consider legal actions such as a claim for damages against them; it planned to disclose the redacted report on or around October 20, 2026.
